request.text: A seamless stable alien rift ambience made of soft stationary granular airflow and continuous subtle electrical shimmer, low mid hollow resonance with fine brighter texture. Nearly uniform density and level from frame to frame. No pulsing, accents, gaps, build, ending, reverb swings, voices or music.

rights.use: Paid plan permits commercial incorporation into a game, subject to terms and prohibited-use policy. Private project review only for isolated clips. Standalone distribution and public sample libraries are outside this review package.
